description: Approximate zonal-mean annual precipitation of Earth (mm/year) at the listed latitudes, read off the GPCP climatology (Adler et al. 2003, J. Hydrometeorol. 4, 1147; 1979-2000 mean): the ITCZ peak north of the equator, subtropical minima, mid-latitude storm-track maxima. Rounded to 50 mm; used as one term of the Earth calibration, with a log tolerance of about 12 %.
